title: Ye Meeting Email Ho Sakti Thi
text:
45 minute ki meeting.
Conclusion: "Chalo isko email pe discuss karte hain."
Bhai, email se hi shuru karte. 📧

title: Bas Ek Quick Call
text:
Boss: Bas ek quick call.
"Quick" = 90 minute.
"Ek" = teen.
Office me shabdon ka matlab alag hota hai. ⏱️

title: Monday Motivation
text:
Sunday raat 10 baje
dimaag me ek ajeeb si udaasi aati hai.
Uska naam hai: kal Monday hai. 😵

title: Appraisal
text:
Manager: Tumne bahut accha kaam kiya, hum bahut khush hain.
Main: Thank you sir. Hike?
Manager: Khushi hike se badi cheez hai.
Bank ko ye baat samjha dijiye. 📈

title: Work From Home
text:
Work from home ka matlab tha:
ghar se kaam.
Nikla:
kaam ke beech me ghar. 🏠💻

title: Urgent Kaam
text:
Shaam 6:55 baje.
Laptop band kar raha tha.
Tabhi message: "Ek chhota sa urgent kaam hai."
"Chhota" aur "urgent" — ye do shabd saath me kabhi sach nahi hote. 🌙

title: Chai Break
text:
Office me sabse zyada productivity
chai break me hoti hai.
Wahan poori company ki strategy ban jaati hai —
bas kisi ko likhni nahi aati. ☕

title: CC Me Boss
text:
Email ka sabse powerful weapon
na subject hai, na body —
balki CC me boss ka naam. 💣

title: Mute Pe Tha
text:
Online meeting ki do hi sachchaiyan hain:
"Mujhe sunayi de raha hai?"
aur "Sorry, main mute pe tha."
Baaki sab bonus hai. 🎧

title: Resign ka Plan
text:
Har mahine ki 25 tareekh ko
resign karne ka mann karta hai.
1 tareekh ko salary aate hi
sudden career growth dikhne lagti hai. 💼

title: Excel ka Jaadu
text:
Excel me ek formula galat lag jaaye
toh poori company ki planning hil jaati hai.
Us cell me desh ka bhavishya hota hai. 📊

title: Team Lunch
text:
Team lunch me 40 minute
sirf restaurant choose karne me jaate hain.
Phir wahi jagah, jahan pichhli baar gaye the. 🍕

title: Deadline Kal Hai
text:
Deadline do hafte door thi — sab shaant.
Deadline kal hai — poori team genius ban gayi.
Pressure ek acchi battery hai. ⚡

title: Interview ka Sawaal
text:
Interviewer: Aapki weakness kya hai?
Main: Main bahut mehnati hoon.
Interviewer: Ye toh strength hai.
Main: Isi confusion me main aaj tak hoon. 🎤

title: Office ka Printer
text:
Office me printer sirf tab kaam karta hai
jab koi dekh raha ho.
Akele jao toh error,
boss ke saath jao toh perfect print. 🖨️

title: Half Day
text:
Half day leave maanga.
Boss: Kya kaam hai?
Main: Zaroori kaam hai.
Boss: Kaunsa?
Main: Jo aapke saamne nahi bol sakta, isliye half day maang raha hoon. 📝
